name: AI Coding Usage
author: Sese-Schneider
description: Display your Claude Code, Kimi and Gemini usage limits and sessions on your Flexbar

Usage.Title: Claude Usage
Usage.Tip: Shows how much of your Claude Code 5-hour and weekly limits is left, or how much of one usage limit is used, as a live meter

Config.Description: Shows usage limits and session status for Claude Code, Kimi and Gemini from the logins and session files already on this computer, with no API key. Every setting below is optional: leave it empty for the default. The refresh interval applies to all three.
Config.ClaudeDir: Claude Code folder for Session Status keys (optional)
Config.KimiRefreshLogin: Refresh an expired Kimi Code login
Config.KimiRefreshLoginHint: On: an expired Kimi Code login is refreshed under the Kimi Code CLI’s own lock, which rewrites ~/.kimi-code/credentials/<slot>.json. Off: the key only reads it and asks you to run kimi.
Config.GeminiCloudProjectHint: Google Cloud project ID for Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise quota; empty uses $GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.

Session.Title: Claude Sessions
Session.Tip: Shows whether your latest Claude Code session is working, done, or waiting for you; press to list running sessions

UI.projectFilterHint: Part of the project path; leave empty for the latest session of any project
UI.notFound: No Claude Code session found in {dir}

NewSession.Title: Claude New Session
NewSession.Tip: Opens a new Claude Code session in the Claude app

UI.folderHint: Absolute path or ~/…; leave empty to let the Claude app choose

KimiUsage.Title: Kimi Usage
KimiUsage.Tip: Shows a Kimi usage limit (Kimi Code plan, or the Kimi Work context) as a live meter

UI.metricContext: Context window of the current Kimi Work task
UI.contextHint: Read from the Kimi desktop app on this computer: how full the running (or latest) Kimi Work task's context window is. No login needed.
UI.contextOnly: Only the Kimi Work context is available. Log in with Kimi Code (run kimi login) for plan limits.
UI.errorNotInstalled: Neither Kimi Code nor the Kimi desktop app was found on this computer.
UI.errorNotConfigured: No Kimi usage data yet. Log in with Kimi Code (run kimi login) for plan limits.
UI.errorNoCredentials: Kimi Code is not logged in. Run kimi login in a terminal.
UI.errorUnauthorized: The Kimi Code login has expired. Run kimi login (or kimi, to refresh it) in a terminal.
UI.errorUnsupported: This login reports no Kimi Code plan usage.
UI.errorRateLimited: Rate limited by Kimi. The key retries later.
UI.errorNetwork: Kimi could not be reached. Check your connection.
UI.errorHttp: Kimi's quota service returned an error. The key retries at the next refresh.
UI.errorParse: Kimi sent an answer the plugin could not read. Try again later, or update the plugin.

KimiSession.Title: Kimi Sessions
KimiSession.Tip: Shows whether your latest Kimi Code session or Kimi Work task is working, done, or waiting for you; press to list running sessions

UI.projectFilterHint: Part of the Kimi Code project path or the Kimi Work project; leave empty for the latest session

KimiNewSession.Title: Kimi New Session
KimiNewSession.Tip: Opens a new Kimi Code session in a terminal, or Kimi Work in the Kimi app

UI.folderHint: Absolute path or ~/…; Kimi Code starts there (empty: your home folder). The Kimi app takes no folder

GeminiUsage.Title: Gemini Usage
GeminiUsage.Tip: Shows your Gemini CLI quota (Gemini Code Assist Standard or Enterprise) as a live meter

UI.problemCliMissing: Gemini CLI was not found on this computer.
UI.problemLoggedOut: Gemini CLI is not logged in.
UI.problemCredsUnreadable: The Gemini CLI login file could not be read.
UI.problemLoginExpired: The Gemini CLI login has expired.
UI.problemPersonal: Google reports no quota for this personal Google account.
UI.problemNotEligible: This Google account is not eligible for Gemini Code Assist.
UI.problemRegion: Gemini Code Assist is not available in your region.
UI.problemVerify: Google asks you to verify this account first: run gemini and follow its link.
UI.problemApiKey: API key logins have no quota information.
UI.problemVertex: Vertex AI logins have no quota information.
UI.problemOtherAuth: This login type has no quota information.
UI.problemNeedsProject: This licence needs a Google Cloud project.
UI.problemProjectDenied: Google refused the Google Cloud project.
UI.problemNeedsSetup: Run gemini once to set up this login.
UI.problemNoQuota: Google has reported no quota yet.
UI.errorNetwork: Google could not be reached. Check your connection.
UI.errorHttp: Google's quota service returned an error. The key retries at the next refresh.
UI.errorRateLimited: Rate limited by Google. The key retries later.
UI.hintCli: Install Gemini CLI, or set its program and folder in the plugin settings.
UI.hintRelogin: Run gemini in a terminal and choose “Login with Google”.
UI.hintPersonal: Google returned no Gemini CLI quota for this personal Google account (it reports the account as not eligible). Only Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise report quota.
UI.hintLogin: Only Gemini CLI's “Login with Google” reports quota. API key and Vertex AI logins have none.
UI.hintProject: Enter your Google Cloud project ID under “Gemini Cloud project” in the plugin settings.

GeminiSession.Title: Gemini Sessions
GeminiSession.Tip: Shows whether your latest Gemini CLI session is working, done, or waiting for you; press to list running sessions

UI.projectFilterHint: Part of the project path; leave empty for the latest session of any project
UI.notFound: No Gemini CLI session found in {dir}
UI.liveDetectionHint: Reads the process list (ps, lsof) every 10 s to tell running sessions from stopped ones; off: judge from the session files only
UI.approvalHint: Gemini CLI records a reply and its tool calls only once the tools have finished, so while a tool waits for your approval, or a question (ask_user) waits for your answer, the key usually still shows the previous reply as “Done”.

GeminiNewSession.Title: Gemini New Session
GeminiNewSession.Tip: Opens a new Gemini CLI session in Terminal

UI.folderHint: Absolute path or ~/…; leave empty for your home folder
UI.terminalHint: Opens Terminal and runs the Gemini CLI in the folder.
UI.appHint: Opens a new chat in the Gemini app: no project folder, not a CLI session.

Usage.Title: Claude 用量
Usage.Tip: 显示 Claude Code 5 小时和每周用量限制还剩多少，或以实时仪表显示单个用量限制已用多少

UI.showClawd: 显示 Clawd（按键宽 170 px 起）

Config.Description: 根据本机已有的登录信息和会话文件，显示 Claude Code、Kimi 和 Gemini 的用量限制与会话状态，无需 API 密钥。以下设置均为可选，留空即使用默认值；刷新间隔对三者都有效。
Config.CredentialsPath: 凭据文件（可选，覆盖默认路径）
Config.Connected: 已连接 — 会话已用 {session}%，本周已用 {weekly}%
Config.ClaudeDir: 会话状态按键使用的 Claude Code 目录（可选）
Config.KimiDesktopDir: Kimi 桌面版数据目录（可选）
Config.KimiRefreshLogin: 自动刷新过期的 Kimi Code 登录
Config.KimiRefreshLoginHint: 开启：在 Kimi Code CLI 自己的锁下刷新过期的 Kimi Code 登录，会改写 ~/.kimi-code/credentials/<slot>.json。关闭：按键只读取登录信息，过期时提示你运行 kimi。
Config.GeminiCloudProjectHint: Gemini Code Assist 标准版或企业版配额使用的 Google Cloud 项目 ID；留空则使用 $GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT。

Session.Title: Claude 会话
Session.Tip: 显示最新的 Claude Code 会话是在进行中、已完成，还是在等你；按下可列出运行中的会话

UI.projectFilterHint: 项目路径的一部分；留空则显示所有项目中最新的会话
UI.notFound: 在 {dir} 中没有找到 Claude Code 会话

NewSession.Title: Claude 新建会话
NewSession.Tip: 在 Claude App 中打开新的 Claude Code 会话

UI.folderHint: 绝对路径或 ~/…；留空则由 Claude App 选择

KimiUsage.Title: Kimi 用量
KimiUsage.Tip: 以实时仪表显示 Kimi 用量限制（Kimi Code 套餐，或 Kimi Work 上下文）

UI.metricDefault: 默认（优先 5 小时限额）
UI.metricMonthlyCode: 每月限额（Kimi Code 部分）
UI.metricContext: 当前 Kimi Work 任务的上下文窗口
UI.contextHint: 读取本机 Kimi 桌面版的数据：正在运行（或最近）的 Kimi Work 任务的上下文窗口占用。无需登录。
UI.contextOnly: 仅能获取 Kimi Work 上下文。登录 Kimi Code（运行 kimi login）即可显示套餐限额。
UI.errorNotInstalled: 本机未找到 Kimi Code 或 Kimi 桌面版。
UI.errorNotConfigured: 暂无 Kimi 用量数据。登录 Kimi Code（运行 kimi login）即可显示套餐限额。
UI.errorNoCredentials: Kimi Code 未登录。请在终端运行 kimi login。
UI.errorUnauthorized: Kimi Code 登录已过期。请在终端运行 kimi login（或运行 kimi 以刷新）。
UI.errorUnsupported: 此账号没有 Kimi Code 套餐用量。
UI.errorRateLimited: Kimi 请求受限，按键稍后自动重试。
UI.errorNetwork: 无法连接 Kimi，请检查网络连接。
UI.errorHttp: Kimi 配额服务返回错误，按键会在下次刷新时重试。
UI.errorParse: 无法读取 Kimi 返回的数据，请稍后重试或更新插件。

KimiSession.Title: Kimi 会话
KimiSession.Tip: 显示最新的 Kimi Code 会话或 Kimi Work 任务是在进行中、已完成，还是在等你；按下可列出运行中的会话

UI.projectFilterHint: Kimi Code 项目路径或 Kimi Work 项目名的一部分；留空则显示最新的会话
UI.notFound: 在 {dir} 中没有找到 Kimi 会话

KimiNewSession.Title: Kimi 新建会话
KimiNewSession.Tip: 在终端中打开新的 Kimi Code 会话，或在 Kimi App 中打开 Kimi Work

UI.folderHint: 绝对路径或 ~/…；Kimi Code 在此启动（留空则为主目录）。Kimi App 不支持指定文件夹
UI.targetCli: 在终端中运行 Kimi Code

GeminiUsage.Title: Gemini 用量
GeminiUsage.Tip: 以实时仪表显示 Gemini CLI 配额（Gemini Code Assist 标准版或企业版）

UI.problemCredsUnreadable: 无法读取 Gemini CLI 的登录文件。
UI.problemPersonal: Google 没有为这个个人 Google 账号返回配额。
UI.problemNotEligible: 此 Google 账号不符合 Gemini Code Assist 的条件。
UI.problemRegion: 你所在的地区不支持 Gemini Code Assist。
UI.problemVerify: Google 要求先验证此账号：请运行 gemini 并打开它给出的链接。
UI.problemApiKey: API Key 登录没有配额信息。
UI.problemVertex: Vertex AI 登录没有配额信息。
UI.problemOtherAuth: 此登录方式没有配额信息。
UI.problemNeedsProject: 此许可需要 Google Cloud 项目。
UI.problemProjectDenied: Google 拒绝了该 Google Cloud 项目。
UI.problemNeedsSetup: 请先运行一次 gemini 以完成此登录的设置。
UI.errorNetwork: 无法连接 Google，请检查网络连接。
UI.errorHttp: Google 配额服务返回错误，按键会在下次刷新时重试。
UI.errorRateLimited: Google 请求受限，按键稍后自动重试。
UI.metricPro: Pro（用量最高的 Pro 模型）
UI.metricFlash: Flash（用量最高的 Flash 模型）
UI.metricPooled: 自动（Pro 与 Flash 合计）
UI.hintCli: 请安装 Gemini CLI，或在插件设置中填写它的程序和目录。
UI.hintRelogin: 请在终端运行 gemini，并选择 “Login with Google” 登录。
UI.hintPersonal: Google 没有为这个个人 Google 账号返回 Gemini CLI 配额（返回结果为不符合条件）。只有 Gemini Code Assist 标准版和企业版会返回配额。
UI.hintLogin: 只有 Gemini CLI 的 “Login with Google” 登录会返回配额，API Key 和 Vertex AI 登录没有配额信息。
UI.hintProject: 请在插件设置的 “Gemini Cloud 项目” 中填写 Google Cloud 项目 ID。

GeminiSession.Title: Gemini 会话
GeminiSession.Tip: 显示最新的 Gemini CLI 会话是在进行中、已完成，还是在等你；按下可列出运行中的会话

UI.projectFilterHint: 项目路径的一部分；留空则显示所有项目中最新的会话
UI.notFound: 在 {dir} 中没有找到 Gemini CLI 会话
UI.liveDetection: 跟踪运行中的 Gemini CLI
UI.liveDetectionHint: 每 10 秒读取进程列表（ps、lsof），以区分运行中和已停止的会话；关闭后仅根据会话文件判断
UI.approvalHint: Gemini CLI 只在工具运行结束后才记录回复和工具调用，因此工具等待你授权、或提问（ask_user）等待你回答时，按键通常仍把上一条回复显示为“已完成”。

GeminiNewSession.Title: Gemini 新建会话
GeminiNewSession.Tip: 在终端中打开新的 Gemini CLI 会话

UI.folderHint: 绝对路径或 ~/…；留空则使用主目录
UI.terminalHint: 打开终端并在该文件夹中运行 Gemini CLI。
UI.appHint: 在 Gemini App 中打开新对话：没有项目文件夹，不是 CLI 会话。
